description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalHelpers module, verifying functions related to decision parsing, command allowlist pattern matching, validation of patterns, and policy requirements within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: parse decision trims and rejects invalid
methods.description: Tests the parsing of decision strings to ensure they are correctly trimmed, parsed, and invalid inputs are rejected.

methods.name: allowlist pattern prefers resolution
methods.description: Verifies that the allowlist pattern matching prefers the resolved path when available, falling back to the raw command name.

methods.name: validate allowlist pattern returns reasons
methods.description: Checks the validation logic for allowlist patterns, ensuring patterns follow expected formats and reason codes are returned accordingly.

methods.name: requires ask matches policy
methods.description: Tests the logic determining whether an ask prompt is required based on various security and allowlist policies.
